name: Letzte Runde - Team Poker
subtitle: Cooperative card game
promotionalText: Cooperative poker for 3 to 8 players: rank your hands from weakest to strongest – without talking about them. Online, on Wi-Fi without internet, or alone against bots.
description:
Letzte Runde (“last round”) is poker turned around: you don’t play against each other – you all play together against the cards.

HOW IT WORKS
• Everyone gets two face-down hole cards, and up to five cards are dealt to the table, just like Texas Hold’em.
• In each of the four rounds everyone takes a chip: 1 for the weakest hand, the highest chip for the strongest.
• Talking about cards is off-limits. You communicate only through the chips – take them from the middle or snatch them from each other.
• At the end, cards are revealed: if the order is right, you all win. If one of you is off, the whole table loses.
• Optionally, you guess together the cards of the player with the highest chip.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Online: create a room, share the link, go. Friends join in the app or simply in the browser – no installation needed.
• On Wi-Fi without internet: your phone hosts the game, the others join via QR code. Perfect for cabins, trains or basements.
• Singleplayer: practise alone against 2 to 5 bots, with a learning mode that explains what’s going on. Works completely offline.
• Table mode: a tablet or TV shows the table big for everyone, while phones show only your own cards.
• Scheduled rounds, bots for empty seats, chat, reactions and optional voice chat.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• Cards are dealt encrypted – neither the server nor other devices can see anyone else’s cards.
• No account needed, no ads, no tracking. An optional account (just name and password, no e-mail) keeps your statistics on all devices and shows a leaderboard with friends.
• Players can be muted and reported, and the host can remove people from the room.

Available in English and German.
Open source: github.com/sgitaize/letzte-runde
Not gambling: no stakes, no real money. Optional tips (“Buy me a Spezi”) unlock nothing.
